fact: The MBSSE EMIS page says FHI 360 and Converge, funded by UNICEF, piloted Global ED*ASSIST with tablets and K-Mobile in one to two districts, and that EMIS is a unit responsible for developing and maintaining an integrated education information system.
The MBSSE EMIS page lists Annual School Census reports for 2015 to 2022 and 2025, and says EMIS is a centralised database with information about every student, teacher and school.
UNICEF published request for proposal 9200546 for a Unique Learner ID (ULID) system and data warehouse with Sierra Leone as beneficiary country, deadline 28 October 2025.
system: Unique Learner ID (ULID) System and Data Warehouse

fact: The Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education has launched a national initiative, funded by GPE, to build a DHIS2-based learner-centred education data hub joining the annual school census, teacher management and examination data, rolling out across all 16 districts.
GPE KIX says Sierra Leone is integrating multiple data systems into a national warehouse and developing a learner-centered EMIS, with a newly drafted EMIS policy and a digital Master Schools List.
